about_project_faq_q2: How do I change the theme and look?
about_project_faq_a2: Open More → Settings → Customization: themes, chat wallpapers and the look of the bottom bar.

about_project_faq_q5: How do I report content or a person?
about_project_faq_a5: Tap ⋯ on a post, a story or in a profile and choose Report. Moderators review every report.
about_project_faq_q6: How do I delete my account?
about_project_faq_a6: More → Settings → Delete account at the very bottom. The account is erased after a waiting period; signing in again during it cancels the deletion.
about_project_faq_q7: How do I reach the team?
about_project_faq_a7: Write to support@riseonly.net or tap Contact support below. We read every message.

moderation_rejected_violations_left: Violations left before a temporary block: {violations_left}
moderation_rejected_next_mutes: The next violation will pause publishing for a while
post_review_pending: Under review. Others will see this post once moderation checks it
post_review_rejected: Rejected by moderation. Only you can see this post
restriction_scope_account: Access to the account is restricted
blocks_auto_explainer: Violations are counted separately for each section. At {limit} the section is restricted for a while, and every next restriction lasts longer.
camera_access_message: Riseonly uses the camera to take photos and videos and the microphone to record sound. You can allow access in your phone Settings.
camera_riffs_hold_hint: Hold the button to record a video
camera_shutter: Take a photo, hold to record a video
voice_invite_sheet_hint: Anyone with this link joins the group and goes straight into this call. The link works until you revoke it.
topic_invite_sheet_hint: Anyone with this link joins the group and goes straight to this topic. The link works until you revoke it.
invite_members_only_hint: Only group members can open this link, because you can't add members. The link works until you revoke it.
voice_invite_create_forbidden: You can't create invite links in this group
voice_invite_preview_private: Join the group to see the call
topic_invite_preview_private: Join the group to open the topic
voice_invite_not_live: Nobody is in the call yet
join_voice_unavailable: This voice chat is no longer available
join_voice_forbidden: You don't have access to this voice chat
join_topic_unavailable: This topic is no longer available
join_topic_forbidden: You don't have access to this topic
join_link_members_only: This link works only for group members
error_story_edit_window_closed: The time to change this story is over
media_link_https_only: Only https links can be added
media_link_limit_reached: You can add up to %d links
media_editor_objects_limit_reached: You can add up to %d objects to a story
media_editor_stickers_limit_reached: You can add up to %d stickers
rtc_call_volume_description: The voices of the others in a call or voice chat.
story_canvas_photos_limit_reached: You can add up to %d photos
error_rtc_overloaded: Calls are under heavy load right now. To keep ongoing calls stable, new ones are on hold for a moment. Try again a little later
chat_poll_public_unavailable: A public poll is available only in groups of up to {limit} members. In channels and larger groups polls are anonymous only.
desktop_tab_bar_order_hint: Drag a button by the handle or right in the left bar to change its place. Buttons can't be removed.
desktop_music_player_close_leave_message: Playback stops and you leave the listening session. Everyone else keeps listening.
desktop_notification_banner_footer: Where notifications appear while Riseonly is open.
desktop_pane_drag_hint: Drag onto another column to swap them. Double-click to reset
desktop_rtc_app_volume_description: Videos, riffs, stories, voice and video messages during a call or voice chat. Call voices and music are not affected.
desktop_rtc_music_volume_description: Same slider as in the player at the bottom of the window. It leaves the call and other sounds alone.
desktop_rtc_microphone_unavailable: No microphone found, or it's in use by another app. Check the input device in your sound settings.
desktop_screen_share_no_portal: Screen sharing isn't available on this desktop. Install xdg-desktop-portal with a ScreenCast backend for your desktop (GNOME, KDE, wlroots or Hyprland) and try again.
desktop_map_unavailable_gpu: The map isn't available on this graphics card
desktop_rtc_speaker_unavailable: Couldn't open your speakers or headphones. Check the output device in your sound settings.
